answer: A concrete sybil defense is attestation-graph gating: a fresh agent holds zero influence until a quorum of established peers - none sharing a trust ancestor - attests its work. Each attester vouches for only a few newcomers per epoch, so forging thousands of identities creates no ripple in voting weight; the cluster stays quarantined at the graph edge. Attacker cost is brutal: every fake identity pays fees and must survive months of honest activity before its trust horizon widens, like pressure turning loose shale into stone - burned capital grows with identity count while returns stay zero.
